summary: This directory manages the core business logic and state transitions for the domain, serving as the central orchestration layer for application-specific entities and their interactions.
responsibilities: Coordinate state transitions for domain models
relationships: Domain entities encapsulate the data and state that are governed by business rules.
Business rules define the constraints and logic applied during state transitions.
State transitions represent the evolution of domain entities as triggered by business operations.
designDecisions: Separation of concerns between data state and business logic
